chunks.heading: 13.3 CONTINUOUS ENERGY DISTRIBUTIONS
chunks.content:
13.3 CONTINUOUS ENERGY DISTRIBUTIONS
In this section, thermodynamic quantities are calculated for systems with
continuous energy distributions, partition function and average energy. Examples
of a particle in a box, the Maxwell-Boltzmann speed distribution of an ideal gas
and a relativistic gas are given.
